'''Raioballo sector''' was a sector in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] encompassing thousands of inhabited worlds.<ref name="COD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> These included the stormy [[Tertiary Kesmere]],<ref name="DFS" /> tranquil [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], oceanic [[Shusugaunt]], the industrial world [[Sinsang]], and [[Anx Space]], containing the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] homeworld of [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]] and a number of their colony worlds.<ref name="GMR" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] [[Myto's Arrow/Legends|Myto's Arrow]] ran through the sector, connecting [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] to the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]].<ref name="BOG" />

Numerous battles were fought in Raioballo sector during the major galactic wars. Fighting occurred at Dantooine during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The last major fleet battle between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant occurred within Anx Space.

==History==
[[File:Horoxryyder.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Raioballo sector senator Horox Ryyder receives the [[Royal Chalcedony Shield]].]]
For many years, Raioballo sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]], an Anx renowned for his level-headed impartiality.<ref name="GMR" /> On his retirement, Ryyder was awarded the [[Royal Chalcedony Shield]], typically only given to [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref> Ryyder was replaced as Raioballo sector senator by fellow Anx [[Zo Howler]] and his aide [[Fo Kuna]].<ref name="GMR" />

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was home to an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] base on Dantooine. However, the base was abandoned before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Shortly after this, Imperial defector [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] tried to hide on the planet, but his defection was detected and an Imperial strike force [[Mission to Dantooine|attacked]] the planet. Celchu was rescued by the intervention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a rebel strike team.<ref name="RS3">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''</ref> Later, when the New Republic came to power, they established a small colony on Dantooine for the refugees from [[Eol Sha]]. This was discovered by the renegade Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] who [[Attack on Dantooine (Galactic Civil War)|massacred]] the colonists as a political strike against the Republic in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

During the period of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the sector contained a large shipyard at [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]], used for scrapping mothballed capital ships. The [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] paid slicers to get the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] transferred there, and then proceeded to [[Battle of Gravlex Med|steal]] the ship which had once been [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] flagship.<ref name="GMR" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:RetreatAtDantooine.jpg|thumb|200px|The Republic engages the Yuuzhan Vong at Dantooine.]]</div>
Years later, another key engagement between the New Republic and the Imperial Remnant occurred in the sector. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]], the navies engaged over [[Anx Minor/Legends|Anx Minor]], with both sides led by their top commanders; Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] and [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], respectively. The battle resulted in victory for the Republic, and was the last large scale fleet engagement fought between the two powers.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Raioballo sector lay along the initial invasion path of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. As such, one of the early engagements of the war took place on Dantooine, in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. New Republic refugees from the further rimward worlds of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] and [[Destrillion]] were being processed on the planet, when the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|launched an attack]]. The invaders killed as many as 45% of the refugees and many soldiers before Admiral [[Traest Kre'fey]] arrived, facilitating escape for the remaining Republic forces.<ref name="DTO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Raioballo was first named in ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', although with no planets named within the sector. That content was supplied by ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Anx]]'' and ''[[Kyle Katarn's Tale]]'', which placed a number of worlds. The specific history of those worlds from other sources could then be extrapolated for the sector.
